_instructions: Administrator alerts shown on the Notifications page, read live. events: each kind raises one alert when it happens threshold times within window_seconds (counted in memory; a restart clears the count); notify false ignores the kind. host_approval raises one alert per host action waiting on the Host Admin page (threshold and window do not apply). severity is info, warning or critical. retention_days: how long alerts are kept. channels: in_app is the Notifications page; ntfy, email and twilio are not available yet and must stay disabled. supply_chain_fixable, supply_chain_failed and supply_chain_stale come from the dependency scan watch: one alert when a high or critical finding with a fix appears that was not alerted before, when the scan fails or its report is unreadable, and when it goes stale (threshold and window do not apply). opt_in_tests_failed comes from the nightly opt-in test watch: one alert when the nightly run of the listed opt-in test groups fails with failures not alerted before (threshold and window do not apply). supply_chain: stale_days (a scan older than this is stale), missed_check_hours (no scanner run recorded for this long is stale), check_seconds (how often the watch reads the scan summary). relay: sweep_seconds (the notification relay moves staged notifications of accounts whose database changed since it last found nothing staged, within about a second; every account with work is looked at again after this many seconds even without a change, as the safety net).
